blocks.text: The movement pattern of a Chinese drilling-capable research vessel that stayed in the vicinity of Bajo de Masinloc or Scarborough Shoal for 28 days indicates that it did not conduct seabed drilling, the Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) said on Tuesday.
